name: After School ~Houkago no Himitsu~
source:
Someone has committed suicide by jumping off a school building. Hinata, Madoka, Ritsuka, and "the girl." What is the secret that is surrounding these 4 classmates? Won't you have a peek at what they are up to after school?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE041904.html]DLsite English[/url]]
